svg.title: RTX 5080 and RTX 5070 Laptop Blosc Pareto frontiers
svg.desc: Four panels compare throughput and compression fold across codecs, filters, and block sizes. Graphical legends identify codec colors, filter shapes, machine line styles, dominated points, and timing ranges.
svg.text: Blosc throughput–compression frontier: RTX 5080 vs RTX 5070 Laptop
Same 200 configurations · u16 · 100 frames · discard sink · 1 warmup + 3 measured runs
Labels: block KiB · per-codec frontier across all filters · higher and farther right is better

svg.text: Empirical frontiers over tested settings. Different OS, driver, compiler, and source revision; speedups are whole-system comparisons.
Fold = padded chunk bytes / sink bytes; compare within each panel. Memory is not an objective here.
Lines connect tested settings only. Current timing ranges are not confidence intervals.
All measured candidates shown. Close frontier rankings are sensitive to timing and ratio precision.
